title: Find the Acceleration Function
text: Acceleration is the derivative of velocity:\n$$a(t) = \frac{dv}{dt} = \frac{d}{dt}(3t^2 - 12t + 9)$$\n$$a(t) = 6t - 12$$

title: Interpret the Result
text: The acceleration at $t = 2$ seconds is $0$ m/s$^2$.\n\nThis means the particle is at the point of inflection between speeding up and slowing down. At $t = 2$, which is between the rest points $t = 1$ and $t = 3$, the velocity is changing from negative to positive (or vice versa) at its maximum rate of change.
